name: Lopamudra Singh

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Lopamudra Singh writes poetry and engages with literature through reading and reviewing. Her contributor note in Literary Vibes describes a background in electrical engineering and work in Odisha’s Commercial Tax and GST administration. The journal has published her poems ‘The City’s Amnesia’ and ‘The Unknowing Void’.

Her Kabita Live poem ‘A Carefree Drift’ imagines an escape into sunshine, mist, waterfalls and wildflowers. Its light rhymes carry the speaker through a landscape of freedom until a clock interrupts the dream. The ending keeps the desire for that nightly return alive, even after waking.
